notesStmt.note: According to Horace Traubel, Whitman gave him these notes on 19 June 1888. The manuscript was therefore composed right around that time, in June 1888.

This manuscript contains the footnote for the poems "Now Precedent Songs, Farewell" and "An Evening Lull," which appeared at the bottom of page 37 in the "Sands at Seventy" section of November Boughs (1888).

body.p: * The two songs on this page are written eked out during an afternoon, June, 1888, in my seventieth year, at a critical spell of illness. Of course no reader and probably no human being at any time will ever have such passages of phases of emotional and solemn powers action as these l involve to these to me.
